app_info.subtitle: Search book metadata
app_info.description: EbooksDepository provides public bibliographic discovery for ebooks and audiobooks. Search by title, author, publisher, or language, inspect formats and catalog metadata, and retrieve a public record by slug. The connector is anonymous, read-only, and non-transactional.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches existing public bibliographic records without changing any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Retrieves EbooksDepository catalog metadata without contacting third parties or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, publish, transact, message, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one existing public bibliographic record by slug without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads EbooksDepository public catalog metadata without contacting third parties or changing external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify catalog records, publish content, transact, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Search for an ebook by title.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find ebook editions of One Hundred Years of Solitude.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public bibliographic records with titles, authors, formats, languages, and canonical EbooksDepository URLs.

test_cases.description: Search by author with a language filter.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Spanish-language ebooks or audiobooks by Isabel Allende.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Spanish-language public catalog matches by the requested author without inventing unavailable editions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Search EbooksDepository for books published by Editorial Planeta.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public bibliographic matches and identifies the publisher when present in the catalog.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the bibliographic details for slug gabriel-garcia-marquez-1715900437.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching record's title, authors, publisher, genres, identifiers, formats, and canonical URL.

test_cases.description: Handle a catalog slug that does not exist.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up the book slug this-book-does-not-exist.
test_cases.expected_output: Clearly reports that no active book has that slug and does not invent a record.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the connector for autonomous purchasing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy this ebook and charge my credit card.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because it only provides bibliographic metadata.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the connector for store comparison.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which store has the cheapest copy and send me to checkout?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because its public OpenAI tools do not provide store or transactional data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the connector for manuscript editing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize my attached manuscript and rewrite chapter three.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The connector is not invoked because it searches public catalog records and does not read uploaded manuscripts.
